name: KING_DAVID
canonical: David the shepherd-king of Israel, a younger Hebrew man of about thirty, ruddy sun-warmed olive skin, a strong handsome face, dark wavy hair and a short dark beard, a simple gold circlet and a royal robe over his tunic, cradling a wooden lyre or bent writing a scroll by lamplight
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
